notes.title: Mediterranea Inferno – Game and Demo coming soon, wishlist today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103680/Mediterranea_Inferno/

Dear friends,

We're excited to share some thrilling news with you today! We have a new game coming later this year - Mediterranea Inferno, a visual novel drama that is quite unlike anything you've played before.

Picture this: A tranquil summer retreat in Italy suddenly spiraling into an eerie mystery. Mediterranea Inferno offers a deep dive into the enigmatic world of three childhood friends who reunite after the isolating 2020 pandemic.

Uncover secrets, confront fears, and navigate obsessions as you traverse through this intense visual novel. The narrative presents a compelling exploration of friendship, desire, and grief, all through the lenses of three antiheroes.

To make sure you don't miss out, you can wishlist Mediterranea Inferno on Steam starting today!

[previewyoutube=_TwHP78G4Jg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A Unique Creation by Lorenzo Redaelli[/b]

This game is another brainchild of Lorenzo Redaelli, the critically acclaimed creator behind the award-winning autobiographical game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302050/Milky_Way_Prince__The_Vampire_Star/]Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star.[/url] 
Once again, Redaelli is not only the writer and director, but also the artist and composer behind this latest venture.

[b]Get A Glimpse Soon[/b]

Can't wait to jump into this treacherous vacation? Well, you won't have to wait long. We're delighted to announce that a demo of Mediterranea Inferno will be available for the upcoming June Steam Next Fest. 

[b]Coming Later This Year[/b]

Mediterranea Inferno is set to make its debut later this year. We're excited to see the game come to life, and even more so, to hear what you think about it!

Until next time,

Pietro and the SR Team

notes.title: Saturnalia - our new game, coming soon and ready to wishlist!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/916350/Saturnalia/

Dear friends,

We hope you're doing well! We have some news to share with you that we think you'll be excited about. Our third-person survival horror adventure, Saturnalia, will be launching on Steam later this year!

What's the game about? It's a single-player third-person survival horror adventure where you play as four characters, experiencing an intergenerational storyline tied to the haunting traditions of an ancient village in Sardinia, Italy, a region rich with unique folklore… 

Chek out this in-depth gameplay trailer to learn more about the game mechanics!

[previewyoutube=OGHYSwMyeAM;full]: [previewyoutube=Wu-dLkGwZd4;full]https://youtu.be/Wu-dLkGwZd4[/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

To make sure you don't miss out on the action, you can wishlist Saturnalia on Steam starting today.

We can't wait for you to join us on this thrilling adventure! As always, thank you for your support, and we'll keep you updated on the latest news about Saturnalia's release.

Happy gaming!

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Milky Way Prince – Available Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=x-TmSgSAX8U;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302050/Milky_Way_Prince__The_Vampire_Star/

In this visual novel, you'll live a summer of dysfunctional love through branching storylines, twists, sudden changes, and a special mechanic where you choose which senses to use with your boyfriend. In these moments, you will learn about him, his personality, and his past, making you question everything.

Milky Way Prince is a semi-autobiographical story entirely designed, programmed, illustrated, and scored by a young author, Lorenzo Redaelli. We can't wait for you to tell us what you think.

Thank you as always,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Milky Way Prince – Our Next Game!
notes.content:

[h1]DEMO available for a liimted time, part of the Steam Game Festival![/h1]

In this visual novel, you'll live a summer of dysfunctional love through branching storylines, twists, sudden changes, and a special mechanic where you choose which senses to use with your boyfriend. In these moments, you will learn about him, his personality, and his past, making you question everything.

Milky Way Prince is a semi-autobiographical story entirely designed, programmed, illustrated, and scored by a young author, Lorenzo Redaelli. We can't wait for you to tell us what you think.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6876205/79ef5f60e6ec0dc0393541a682a24d7f0e07c844.gif[/img]

In the last ten years we've learned to do all the set up and promotion a game requires when commercially released, so we though we could use those skills for discovering and showcasing new games to fall in love with. Milky Way Prince was the perfect opportunity to use what we learned for something we care for.

Thank you as always,

Pietro and the team at SR

https://youtu.be/SnFBqt3Mkyw

notes.title: Wheelspedia now available!
notes.content:
We’ve compiled a useful wiki of all the events, people and places that are mentioned in the dialogues, so that you have a chance to learn more about them without leaving the game. These are unlocked one at a time by choosing the relevant dialogue options and are accessible from the pause menu OR the EXTRAS menu. This is the last update for Wheels of Aurelia for the near future, we’ve delayed indefinitely the “Night Mode”, we might resume development on it if there is enough interest. Thank you so much for playing!

[list]
[*][b]NOW AVAILABLE – Wheelspedia: an in-game and in-menu text archive offering some details on the people, places, and events mentioned in Wheels of Aurelia.[/b]
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303801/0d55561a74f6510643b7237cf37161d610095e7d.jpg[/img]

New options:[list]
[*]PREVIOUSLY – Text Speed: the text display speed will be configurable between 50% and 100%. Also now you can hold accelerator during cutscenes to move dialogue faster.
[*]PREVIOUSLY – Start From: after visiting both Civitavecchia and Bracciano for the first time, you will be able to start the game from one of these two locations, or Rome, or the intro sequence.
[*]PREVIOUSLY – Vibration: haptic feedback for collisions will be activated on compatible joypads.[/list]

New modes:[list]
[*]PREVIOUSLY – B&W Mode: a new unlockable filter option to play the game through a black and white TV set.
[*]PREVIOUSLY – 1978 Mode: a new unlockable filter option to play the game through a 1978 TV set.
[*]PREVIOUSLY – Map: a unlockable option to hide the menu and navigate the underlying map of the roads in Wheels of Aurelia.
[*]PREVIOUSLY – Scenic Mode: an unlockable option to manipulate the camera angle during gameplay and to take expressive screenshots.
[*]NOW AVAILABLE – Wheelspedia: an in-game and in-menu text archive offering some details on the people, places, and events mentioned in Wheels of Aurelia.
[*]DELAYED INDEFINITELY – Night Mode: an unlockable arcade mode that takes place by night, inspired by isometric racers of the 90s.[/list]

All of these will be available under a new EXTRAS menu available in the main menu. 
New languages: [list]
[*]PREVIOUSLY – Russian
[*]LAST WEEK – German[/list]

Let us know what you think!

Cheers,
Pietro

notes.title: Scenic Mode Now Available!
notes.content:
Sorry everyone for the delay! We’ve been hard at work on our biggest update. The scenic mode is now available, just access the EXTRAS menu after achieving the requirements to activate it. In this new mode, hold the right button on your mouse and move it to choose a different camera angle. You can also click the right button to get various levels of zoom. Now go get that perfect shot of the Italian coast! We are also continuing the deployment of fixes and updates to hit the game between now and early 2017. notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Wheels of Aurelia
notes.content:
Wheels of Aurelia is Now Available on Steam!

A narrative road trip game set in the roaring Italian 70s, it tells the story of Lella, a restless woman driving on the roads of the western coast of Italy, the famous “Via Aurelia”.
